subject.title: fix: allow custom control UI origins

question: Should this PR remain blocked until the contributor supplies redacted live Gateway or desktop-wrapper proof, or can maintainers explicitly accept source, CI, and Gateway harness proof for this auth parser fix?
rationale: The code path is small and source-backed, but it changes a browser-origin authorization boundary and the external-PR real behavior proof gate is not satisfied by tests and CI alone.

options.title: Require live allowlist proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live Gateway or desktop-wrapper evidence showing an exact custom-scheme origin accepted and an unlisted custom-scheme origin rejected before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the proof gate if the unit tests, Gateway handshake test, and source review are enough for this bounded parser change.

options.title: Choose a sibling fix path
options.body: If maintainers prefer another open candidate for the same canonical issue, pause this PR until one exact-origin fix is selected.

recommendation.title: Require live allowlist proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Gateway or desktop-wrapper evidence showing an exact custom-scheme origin accepted and an unlisted custom-scheme origin rejected before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest history on the affected Gateway origin-security boundary and introduced the original Control UI origin hardening.
